summary.title: REVISORTEAM AS

narrative.text: REVISORTEAM AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning", registered 1995-02-19.
Registered activity: Revisjon, rådgivning, kursvirksomhet og deltagelse i andre foretagender.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 461,542 and an annual result of NOK 5,878.
Head office in Notodden, with 1 registered workplace.
